sentences.en: He is not better off because he is poorly paid.
sentences.zh: 他的收入很低，因此他并不富裕。

sentences.en: Don't despise a man just because he is poorly dressed.
sentences.zh: 不要仅仅因为他衣着破旧就看不起一个人。

sentences.en: He left his poorly paid job for greener pastures elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 他辞去了报酬低的工作，去别处寻找更好的机会。

senses.zh: 身体不舒服的；心情恶劣的
贫穷地；贫乏地；不充分地
